_doc: Render-time colours (#38), applied by export_meshes.py + render.py; first matching rule wins, unmatched parts keep the model's colour. Hex = sRGB. Decided by the user 2026-11-06.

frame.note: TENTATIVE: DLLPDF in-stock RAL 6011 (Dull Green), Prismatic gloss, chosen by the user 2026-11-14 (#101). Paint = Prismatic product photo #6E8C5B; hex here = render albedo that makes the lit front bar render as #6E8C5B under this scene's lights (re-tune if render.py lighting changes; method in notes/reference/frame-colour.html); confirm against the physical sample, https://github.com/dvystrcil/vt350/issues/102

monolith.note: LDO Monolith milled parts (VC9-*/VT9-*), matte black (user, 2026-11-06)

brushed_steel.note: levelling feet: the DK-08 base, bolt and jam nut, the bracket and its M5 screws + lock washers, brushed steel (user, 2026-11-16, #83)

orbiter.note: Orbiter extruder body + motor, black metal (user, 2026-11-14, #19; placeholder hex until photos of the user's parts)

black_plastic.note: Orbiter Smart Sensor + Orbitool O2S toolboard housings + the toolhead fans (the 2510 hotend fan; the Vindr Berserker 4010B part-cooling blowers, lite-37), black plastic (user, 2026-11-14, #19, LH Stinger photo; placeholder hex)

dragon_heatsink.note: Phaetus Dragon ACE Volcano finned outer heat sink, black anodised (user's photo on #19, 2026-11-14)

copper.note: Dragon ACE copper core, seen through the heat sink's window (user's photo on #19, 2026-11-14)

dragon_orange.note: Dragon ACE orange ring under the copper core (user's photo on #19, 2026-11-14)

brass.note: the O2S board's standoffs between the Orbiter and the board, brass (user, 2026-11-14, #19); their screws share the part and may be brass too (user: fine)

foil.note: the aluminium foil the carbon felt is sealed in (lite-16 insulation liners, #19, 2026-11-14)

carbon_felt.note: carbon felt insulation pads (lite-16), black-grey; seen only at the cut edges between the foil liners (#19, 2026-11-14)

panel_paint.note: the panels' outsides, spray-painted by the user to match the frame (user, 2026-11-14, #19): a shade off the frame's RAL 6011 and less glossy, a rattle can; the insides stay white

glass_clear.note: the door window, clear sheet (acrylic or polycarbonate: #4) (user, 2026-11-14, #19)

brushed_aluminium.note: the CNC Crossbow on each head (main body, top cap, lever, blade caddy), brushed aluminium (user, 2026-11-14, #19); also the e-box DIN rails (user, 2026-11-16)

stepper.note: NEMA17 stepper bodies (A, B, 3 x Z), black (owner, 2026-11-18, #220); the real motors have silver end caps, but each body is one solid in the model, so all black until it is split

o2s_heatsink.note: Orbitool O2S toolboard heat sink (13 fins), blue anodised aluminium (user, 2026-11-14, #19; split out of the board by lite-34; placeholder hex until photos)

hardware.note: PLACEHOLDER hex for the owner to pick (#149): fasteners, washers, nuts, T-nuts, pins, springs, magnets, and any steel part no other rule claims. Starts at brushed_steel's hex so nothing changes look before the owner decides (black oxide or stainless are the usual Voron choices)

stock_aluminium.note: PLACEHOLDER hex for the owner to pick (#149): aluminium no earlier rule claims (the kinematic bed mount's plates, the build plate, the milled dock). Starts at brushed_aluminium's hex

electronics.note: PLACEHOLDER hex for the owner to pick (#149): circuit boards (PCBs), green solder mask; the owner's boards may be black
